rows.text: clears byte `[rcx]` and, when `dx` is not -1 and dword `+0x284` of the `0x740`-byte record indexed by the sign-extended `dx` in the array at qword `022C6F28` is non-zero, sets byte `[rcx]` to 1, stores `edx` to dword `rcx+8` and the record's qword `+0x108` to qword `rcx+0x10`, and stores the low byte returned by the call at `0046C1E0` + 0x4B (with `ecx` 9) plus 3 to byte `rcx+4`; otherwise only the cleared byte is written
replaces dword `rcx+0x30` with `0020E620(0020E600(dword rcx+0x30) + edx)` (32-bit sum) and returns that value

notes: 0046C1E0: the callee at + 0x4B is not named in the host excerpt; cited by site. The record-pointer cmove (0046C20C) only nulls on a zero +0x284. 00512C50: 0020E600 and 0020E620 are both named in the host excerpt, so they are named by address.
